basic_info.description: This long time family owned, lived & loved Mission Terrace 1928 built single family home located on a cul-de-sac off Cayuga Avenue. The upstairs features original hardwood floors, a large living room with bay windows, fireplace, original built in cabinets at each side of the fireplace and French doors that open to the dining room perfect for entertaining and holiday get togethers with a butler's sliding window, and chef's swing door to easily pass meals between kitchen and dining room. Kitchen has built in bench seating and cabinet, original ironing board cabinet, iron cubby, dishwasher, gas stove, oven, overhead built in microwave, and behind the sink unfinished window area with two ceiling hung Tiffany-like lights that makes this big kitchen nice and bright. 1 split/2 half baths at hallway, front door 1 coat and 1 hall closets, and 2 bedrooms both with closets, and a bonus sunroom that looks over and with access to the low maintenance backyard. The backyard and covered deck to enjoy morning coffee, evening wine or relax with a good book. 1 car garage includes washer and dryer and lots of shelving. Close to US Post Office, Mission Street's array of eats and shop treats, Safeway, Balboa Park, public transportation and freeways.
